title: What happens when the exit monitor cannot take its first price

options.name: Keep current behaviour: log and return, no monitor until a restart
options.risk: A held position has no stop-loss, trailing or 30-minute exit, and the operator is not alerted (AUD-EXIT-002).

options.name: Retry the first quote with backoff inside a bounded window, then alert loudly if it still fails
options.behavior_impact: The monitor usually starts within seconds; a persistent failure is visible.
options.risk: If every retry fails the position is still unmonitored, only now announced.

options.name: Persist exit_state with no entry price and arm the interval; baseline on the first good quote, urgency counts from the buy
options.behavior_impact: Every landed buy always has an armed monitor and a persisted row.
options.risk: Needs the poll loop to handle a missing baseline everywhere it divides by it.

recommendation: arm-unbaselined, with an alert after N consecutive null quotes.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether a landed buy can ever be left without an exit monitor.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
